hadi-march/managers#managerChannel.name: managerChannel
hadi-march/managers#managerChannel.doc: The `managers` channel: every manager event with the topic `<manager>:<type>` (keeps the last 50 for late listeners).
hadi-march/managers#managerChannel.tr: `managers` kanalı: her yönetici olayı `<manager>:<type>` konusuyla gelir (geç gelen dinleyiciler için son 50'yi tutar).

hadi-march/managers#managerChannelOf.name: managerChannelOf
hadi-march/managers#managerChannelOf.doc: The channel one manager publishes to ("managers.<name>").

hadi-march/managers#memoryTransport.name: memoryTransport
hadi-march/managers#memoryTransport.doc: Keeps the last `size` entries as a reactive list (`entries()`), newest first.
hadi-march/managers#memoryTransport.signature: function memoryTransport(size: number = 100): Transport & { entries: Accessor<readonly LogEntry[]>; clear(): void }

returns.type: Transport & { entries: Accessor<readonly LogEntry[]>; clear(): void }

hadi-march/managers#memoryTransport.tr: Son `size` kaydı, en yeni başta olacak şekilde tepkisel bir liste (`entries()`) olarak tutar.

hadi-march/managers#normalizeShortcut.name: normalizeShortcut
hadi-march/managers#normalizeShortcut.doc: "mod+shift+k" → one canonical string for this platform.
hadi-march/managers#normalizeShortcut.tr: "mod+shift+k" → bu platform için tek bir standart dize.

hadi-march/managers#notifications.name: notifications
hadi-march/managers#notifications.doc: The notification manager (created on first call; asks nothing until request()).
hadi-march/managers#notifications.tr: Bildirim yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur; request() çağrılana kadar bir şey istemez).

hadi-march/managers#onCommandRun.name: onCommandRun
hadi-march/managers#onCommandRun.doc: History hook: called after every successful run (undo / redo, audit log). Returns off.
hadi-march/managers#onCommandRun.tr: Geçmiş kancası: her başarılı çalıştırmadan sonra çağrılır (geri al / yinele, denetim günlüğü). off döndürür.

hadi-march/managers#onManager.name: onManager
hadi-march/managers#onManager.doc: Listen to manager events by topic: "idle:idle", "session:*", "*". Returns off (removed with the owning component). Replayed messages are skipped unless `replay` is true.
hadi-march/managers#onManager.signature: function onManager(pattern: string, fn: (m: ManagerMessage) => void, opts: { replay?: boolean } = {}): () => void
hadi-march/managers#onManager.tr: Yönetici olaylarını konuya göre dinler: "idle:idle", "session:*", "*". off döndürür (sahip bileşenle birlikte kaldırılır). `replay` true değilse yeniden oynatılan iletiler atlanır.

hadi-march/managers#perf.name: perf
hadi-march/managers#perf.doc: The performance manager (created on first call; observers start then).
hadi-march/managers#perf.tr: Performans yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur; gözlemciler o zaman başlar).

hadi-march/managers#perfManager.name: perfManager
hadi-march/managers#perfManager.tr: Performans yöneticisinin kendisi: get(), configure(), dispose(), alive().

hadi-march/managers#permissions.name: permissions
hadi-march/managers#permissions.doc: The permission manager (created on first call).

hadi-march/managers#persisted.name: persisted
hadi-march/managers#persisted.doc: A signal kept in local (or session) storage: reads the stored value now, writes on every set, follows other tabs. The value goes through the same prefix, version and migrations.
hadi-march/managers#persisted.signature: function persisted<T>(key: string, initial: T, opts: { area?: "local" | "session"; ttl?: number | string } = {}): Signal<T>
hadi-march/managers#persisted.tr: Yerel (veya oturum) depolamada tutulan sinyal: saklı değeri hemen okur, her atamada yazar, diğer sekmeleri izler. Değer aynı önek, sürüm ve taşıma adımlarından geçer.

hadi-march/managers#pickCommands.name: pickCommands
hadi-march/managers#pickCommands.doc: Commands picked by ids, a group or a filter (reactive: only the permitted ones).
hadi-march/managers#pickCommands.tr: Kimliklere, bir gruba veya süzgece göre seçilen komutlar (tepkisel: yalnız izin verilenler).

hadi-march/managers#presence.name: presence
hadi-march/managers#presence.doc: The presence manager (created on first call; starts Idle and Window).
hadi-march/managers#presence.tr: Varlık yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur; Idle ve Window'u başlatır).

hadi-march/managers#publisher.name: publisher
hadi-march/managers#publisher.doc: A function that reports `type` + `detail` for one manager (on its channels, see emit()).
hadi-march/managers#publisher.signature: function publisher(name: string): (type: string, detail?: unknown) => void
hadi-march/managers#publisher.tr: Bir yönetici için `type` + `detail` bildiren işlev (kanallarında, bkz. emit()).

hadi-march/managers#rateLimit.name: rateLimit
hadi-march/managers#rateLimit.doc: The rate limiter (created on first call).

hadi-march/managers#rateManager.name: rateManager
hadi-march/managers#rateManager.doc: The rate limit manager (get, configure, dispose).

hadi-march/managers#rateVital.name: rateVital
hadi-march/managers#rateVital.doc: Rate a Web Vitals value as good, needs improvement or poor (Google thresholds).
hadi-march/managers#rateVital.signature: function rateVital(name: VitalName, v: number): Rating
hadi-march/managers#rateVital.tr: Bir Web Vitals değerini iyi, iyileştirilmeli veya zayıf olarak derecelendirir (Google eşikleri).

hadi-march/managers#scroll.name: scroll
hadi-march/managers#scroll.doc: The scroll manager (created on first call).

hadi-march/managers#session.name: session
hadi-march/managers#session.doc: The session manager (created on first call; nothing runs until start()).
hadi-march/managers#session.tr: Oturum yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur; start() çağrılana kadar bir şey çalışmaz).

hadi-march/managers#shortcutHintManager.name: shortcutHintManager
hadi-march/managers#shortcutHintManager.doc: The shortcut hint manager (get, configure, dispose).

hadi-march/managers#shortcutHints.name: shortcutHints
hadi-march/managers#shortcutHints.doc: The shortcut hint manager. Every method goes to the one instance (created on first use).
hadi-march/managers#shortcutHints.value:
{
  visible: () => manager.get().visible(),
  show: () => untrack(() => manager.get()).show(),
  hide: () => untrack(() => manager.get()).hide(),
  openHelp: () => untrack(() => manager.get()).openHelp(),
  closeHelp: () => untrack(() => manager.get()).closeHelp(),
  helpOpen: () => manager.get().helpOpen(),
  entries: () => manager.get().entries(),
  targets: (r) => untrack(() => manager.get()).targets(r),
  dispose: () => manager.dispose(),
}
hadi-march/managers#shortcutHints.tr: Kısayol ipucu yöneticisi. Her yöntem tek örneğe gider (ilk kullanımda oluşturulur).

hadi-march/managers#storage.name: storage
hadi-march/managers#storage.doc: The storage manager (created on first call).

hadi-march/managers#sync.name: sync
hadi-march/managers#sync.doc: The sync manager (created on first call; sends what an earlier visit left in the queue).
hadi-march/managers#sync.tr: Eşitleme yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur; önceki bir ziyaretten kuyrukta kalanları gönderir).

hadi-march/managers#undoCommands.name: undoCommands
hadi-march/managers#undoCommands.doc: Register "edit.undo" (mod+z) and "edit.redo" (mod+shift+z); removed with the current owner.
hadi-march/managers#undoCommands.tr: "edit.undo" (mod+z) ve "edit.redo" (mod+shift+z) komutlarını kaydeder; geçerli sahiple birlikte kaldırılır.

hadi-march/managers#undoStack.name: undoStack
hadi-march/managers#undoStack.doc: The app's undo history (created on first call).
hadi-march/managers#undoStack.tr: Uygulamanın geri alma geçmişi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur).

hadi-march/managers#viewport.name: viewport
hadi-march/managers#viewport.doc: The viewport manager (created on first call). Reading its methods inside bindings is reactive.
hadi-march/managers#viewport.tr: Görünüm alanı yöneticisi (ilk çağrıda oluşturulur). Yöntemlerini bağlamalar içinde okumak tepkiseldir.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentBa.name: ConsentBanner
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentBa.doc: Bottom banner, shown while there is no valid decision for the current policy version.

props.name: always
props.doc: Show even when a decision is already stored (demos); a choice made on the banner still closes it.

props.name: inline
props.doc: Render in place, in the page flow, instead of the bottom layer (demos).

props.name: title
props.doc: Banner / panel title.

props.name: text
props.doc: Banner text: the app's own wording (its legal text).

props.name: policyLabel
props.doc: Label of the policy link (shown when configureConsent({ policyHref }) is set).

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentBa.tr: Alt şerit; geçerli politika sürümü için geçerli bir karar yokken gösterilir.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentGa.name: ConsentGate
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentGa.doc: Renders its children only while `category` is granted; otherwise a placeholder that can grant it in place.

props.name: label
props.doc: What the placeholder says (default: a generic "This content is blocked" text).

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#ConsentGa.tr: Alt öğelerini yalnız `category` verilmişken çizer; aksi halde yerinde izin verilebilen bir yer tutucu gösterir.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#hideConse.name: hideConsentBanner
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#hideConse.doc: Close the banner; a choice made on it calls this. It comes back when the stored decision changes or goes away.
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#hideConse.tr: Şeridi kapatır; üzerinde yapılan bir seçim bunu çağırır. Saklı karar değişince veya silinince geri gelir.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#openConse.name: openConsentPreferences
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#openConse.doc: The detailed panel. Resolves to true when the user saved a choice, false when dismissed.
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#openConse.tr: Ayrıntılı panel. Kullanıcı bir seçimi kaydettiyse true, kapattıysa false ile çözülür.

hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#showConse.name: showConsentBanner
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#showConse.doc: Show the banner again, even when a decision is stored (a "cookie settings" link, demos).
hadi-march/managers/consent/ui#showConse.tr: Saklı bir karar olsa bile şeridi yeniden gösterir ("çerez ayarları" bağlantısı, demolar).

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#bindComma.name: bindCommandKeys
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#bindComma.doc: Bind every registered command's shortcut (through ui/keys). Re-binds when commands change. Returns unbind. Simple binding: no scopes, the newest command wins a conflict.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.name: commandBinding
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandBi.doc: Bind a toolbar / status bar item to a command id (OverflowToolbar, StatusBar): its own `label`, `icon`, `shortcut`, `disabled` and `onSelect` override the command's. Reactive: a command registered later is picked up.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandBu.name: CommandButton
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandBu.doc: A Button bound to a command: runs it, shows its busy state, follows `when` and `can`.

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.name: commandItems
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.doc: Menu items from the registry (reactive accessor: commands registered later appear).

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandIt.tr: Kayıt defterinden menü öğeleri (tepkisel erişimci: sonradan kaydedilen komutlar görünür).

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#commandMe.name: commandMenuItem

hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.name: CommandToolbar
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.doc: A toolbar (button group) filled from the registry.
hadi-march/managers/command/ui#CommandTo.tr: Kayıt defterinden doldurulan araç çubuğu (düğme grubu).

hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.name: undoHistory
hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.doc: A separate history with the same engine (merge window, transactions, saved point); events go nowhere.
hadi-march/managers/undo#undoHistory.tr: Aynı motorla ayrı bir geçmiş (birleştirme penceresi, işlemler, kaydedilmiş nokta); olaylar hiçbir yere gitmez.

props.doc: Accessible name.

hadi-march/managers/undo/history#create.name: create
hadi-march/managers/undo/history#create.doc: An undo stack with the given config; `pub` reports its events (UndoManager wires it to its channel).
hadi-march/managers/undo/history#create.signature: function create(cfg: UndoConfig, pub: (type: string, detail?: unknown) => void = () => {}): UndoStack
hadi-march/managers/undo/history#create.tr: Verilen yapılandırmayla bir geri alma yığını; `pub` olaylarını bildirir (UndoManager bunu kanalına bağlar).

hadi-march/seo#applyHead.name: applyHead
hadi-march/seo#applyHead.doc: Write tags to document.head: update in place, restore or remove what is no longer wanted. `scripts: false` leaves JSON-LD alone (neither written nor removed: blocks from the build stay).
hadi-march/seo#applyHead.signature: function applyHead(tags: readonly Tag[], __1: { lang?: string | undefined; scripts?: boolean } = {}, doc: Document | undefined = globalThis.document): void
hadi-march/seo#applyHead.tr: Etiketleri document.head'e yazar: yerinde günceller, artık istenmeyenleri geri yükler veya kaldırır. `scripts: false` JSON-LD'ye dokunmaz (ne yazılır ne kaldırılır: derlemeden gelen bloklar kalır).

hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.name: checkHtml
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.doc: Check one page. Errors: what search engines need; warnings: what most pages should have.
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.signature: function checkHtml(html: string, opts: SeoCheckOptions = {}): SeoIssue[]
hadi-march/seo#checkHtml.tr: Tek bir sayfayı denetler. Hatalar: arama motorlarının gereksindiği; uyarılar: çoğu sayfada olması gereken.

hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.name: formatIssues
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.doc: One line per issue, for terminals and previews.
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.signature: function formatIssues(file: string, issues: readonly SeoIssue[]): string
hadi-march/seo#formatIssues.tr: Sorun başına bir satır; uçbirimler ve önizlemeler için.

hadi-march/seo#headTags.name: headTags
hadi-march/seo#headTags.doc: The tags written to <head> now (reactive): previews, tests.
hadi-march/seo#headTags.tr: Şu an <head> içine yazılan etiketler (tepkisel): önizlemeler, testler.

hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.name: headToHtml
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.doc: Tags as HTML text (build time, previews). `mark` adds data-hm-head so the client adopts them.
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.signature: function headToHtml(tags: readonly Tag[], __1: { mark?: boolean } = {}): string
hadi-march/seo#headToHtml.tr: Etiketleri HTML metni olarak verir (derleme zamanı, önizlemeler). `mark` istemcinin sahiplenmesi için data-hm-head ekler.

hadi-march/seo#installSeo.name: installSeo
hadi-march/seo#installSeo.doc: Turn on route heads: the router hands each route's `head` (and title) here on every navigation.
hadi-march/seo#installSeo.tr: Rota başlıklarını açar: yönlendirici her gezinmede her rotanın `head` (ve title) değerini buraya verir.

hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.name: jsonLdText
hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.doc: JSON for a <script type="application/ld+json"> body: "</script" and "<!--" can never close or confuse the element.
hadi-march/seo#jsonLdText.tr: Bir <script type="application/ld+json"> gövdesi için JSON: "</script" ve "<!--" öğeyi asla kapatamaz veya şaşırtamaz.

hadi-march/seo#ld.name: ld
hadi-march/seo#ld.doc: JSON-LD builders: WebSite, Organization, Article, Product, Breadcrumb, FAQ.
hadi-march/seo#ld.signature: const ld: { website: (o: { name: string; url: string; search?: string; }) => JsonLd; organization: (o: OrgInput) => JsonLd; breadcrumbs: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[], site?: string) => JsonLd; article: (o: ArticleInput) => JsonLd; product: (o: ProductInput) => JsonLd; faq: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => JsonLd; }
hadi-march/seo#ld.valueType: { website: (o: { name: string; url: string; search?: string; }) => JsonLd; organization: (o: OrgInput) => JsonLd; breadcrumbs: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[], site?: string) => JsonLd; article: (o: ArticleInput) => JsonLd; product: (o: ProductInput) => JsonLd; faq: (items: readonly (readonly [string, string])[]) => JsonLd; }
hadi-march/seo#ld.tr: JSON-LD oluşturucuları: WebSite, Organization, Article, Product, Breadcrumb, FAQ.

hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.name: resolveHead
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.doc: Merge head inputs (later ones win) into the list of tags to write.
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.signature: function resolveHead(inputs: readonly (HeadInput | null | undefined | false)[], opts: ResolveOptions = {}): Tag[]
hadi-march/seo#resolveHead.tr: Başlık girdilerini birleştirir (sonrakiler kazanır) ve yazılacak etiket listesini üretir.

hadi-march/seo#scanTags.name: scanTags
hadi-march/seo#scanTags.doc: Start tags (with attributes) and the text of raw-text elements, in document order.
hadi-march/seo#scanTags.tr: Başlangıç etiketleri (öznitelikleriyle) ve ham metin öğelerinin metni, belge sırasıyla.

hadi-march/seo#tagKey.name: tagKey
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.doc: The key a tag (as attributes) is matched by: the same rules for tags written here and tags found in the HTML.
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.signature: function tagKey(tag: string, a: Record<string, string | null | undefined>): string | null
hadi-march/seo#tagKey.tr: Bir etiketin (öznitelikleri olarak) eşleştirildiği anahtar: burada yazılan etiketler ve HTML'de bulunanlar için aynı kurallar.

hadi-march/seo#useHead.name: useHead
hadi-march/seo#useHead.doc: Add head tags while the calling component lives (removed with it). `input` may be a function: it is tracked, so signals read inside update the head.
hadi-march/seo#useHead.signature: function useHead(input: HeadInput | (() => HeadInput | null | undefined)): () => void
hadi-march/seo#useHead.tr: Çağıran bileşen yaşadığı sürece başlık etiketleri ekler (onunla birlikte kaldırılır). `input` bir işlev olabilir: izlenir, içinde okunan sinyaller başlığı günceller.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.name: hydrate
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.doc: Take over prerendered HTML (data-hm-prerender) without a flash, or render normally when there is none.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.signature: function hydrate(fn: () => unknown, el: Element, opts: HydrateOptions = {}): () => void
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#hydrate.tr: Önceden oluşturulmuş HTML'i (data-hm-prerender) titremeden devralır; yoksa normal çizer.

hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.name: prerenderedFor
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.doc: True when the URL shows the route prerendered into `el` (data-hm-prerender: "#/x" for hash routing, else "/x"). History routing compares the end of the path, so it works under any base; "/" matches only a folder URL.
hadi-march/seo/hydrate#prerenderedFor.tr: URL, `el` içine önceden oluşturulmuş rotayı gösteriyorsa true (data-hm-prerender: karma yönlendirmede "#/x", aksi halde "/x"). Geçmiş yönlendirmesi yolun sonunu karşılaştırır, böylece her tabanda çalışır; "/" yalnız klasör URL'sine uyar.

hadi-march/managers/accessibility/ui#Acc.name: AccessibilitySettings
hadi-march/managers/accessibility/ui#Acc.doc: Every preference, applied as it changes.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.name: comboOf
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.doc: aria-keyshortcuts ("Control+Shift+S", first of several) or data-hotkey ("mod+shift+s") → a combo for formatKey.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint#comboO.tr: aria-keyshortcuts ("Control+Shift+S", birden çoksa ilki) veya data-hotkey ("mod+shift+s") → formatKey için bir birleşim.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.name: holdHint
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.doc: "Hold Alt to see shortcuts" line for a footer or a help page.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#hol.tr: Alt bilgi veya yardım sayfası için "Kısayolları görmek için Alt'a basılı tutun" satırı.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.name: ShortcutHelp
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.doc: The help list, grouped; inactive ones (another scope, under a modal) are dimmed.
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.tr: Gruplanmış yardım listesi; etkin olmayanlar (başka kapsam, kipli pencere altında) soluk gösterilir.

hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.name: ShortcutHints
hadi-march/managers/shortcut-hint/ui#Sho.doc: Mount once (e.g. in the app shell).

hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.name: RICH_SCHEMA
hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.doc: Rich text: paragraphs, headings, quotes, lists, code, links, emphasis.
hadi-march/dom/safe#RICH_SCHEMA.tr: Zengin metin: paragraflar, başlıklar, alıntılar, listeler, kod, bağlantılar, vurgu.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.name: BLOCKS
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.doc: Block-level elements (normalizeBlocks keeps them at the top level).
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#BLOCKS.tr: Blok düzeyi öğeler (normalizeBlocks bunları en üst düzeyde tutar).

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.name: decodeEntities
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.doc: Decode character references (& ' 😀 and common named ones).
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#decodeEntities.tr: Karakter başvurularını çözer (& ' 😀 ve yaygın adlandırılmış olanlar).

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.name: normalizeBlocks
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.doc:
Make `root`'s children a clean list of blocks: runs of inline nodes are wrapped in

,

and other containers are flattened, whitespace between blocks is removed, a

inside

  • /
    is unwrapped (
    between), and h1 becomes h2 when `topHeading` is 2. Returns root.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.signature: function normalizeBlocks<T extends Node>(root: T, opts: { topHeading?: number } = {}): T
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#normalizeBlocks.tr:
`root`'un alt öğelerini temiz bir blok listesi yapar: satır içi düğüm dizileri

içine sarılır,

ve diğer kapsayıcılar düzleştirilir, bloklar arası boşluk kaldırılır,
  • /
    içindeki

    açılır.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.name: parseHtml
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.doc: Parse an HTML string into a fragment of allowlisted nodes. Inline styles are read only to keep emphasis that office suites encode as styles (font-weight, font-style, text-decoration); they are never copied.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.signature: function parseHtml(html: string, schema: SafeSchema = RICH_SCHEMA, d: Document = globalThis.document): DocumentFragment
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#parseHtml.tr: Bir HTML dizesini izin verilen düğümlerden oluşan bir parçaya ayrıştırır. Satır içi stiller yalnızca ofis uygulamalarının stil olarak kodladığı vurguyu (font-weight, font-style, text-decoration) korumak için okunur; asla kopyalanmaz.

hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.name: sanitizeNode
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.doc: Copy `node`'s children through the schema (the same rules as parseHtml) into a new fragment.
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.signature: function sanitizeNode(node: Node, schema: SafeSchema = RICH_SCHEMA): DocumentFragment
hadi-march/dom/sanitize#sanitizeNode.tr: `node`'un alt öğelerini şemadan geçirerek (parseHtml ile aynı kurallar) yeni bir parçaya kopyalar.

hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.name: toMarkdown
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.doc: Write a DOM tree (a root whose children are blocks: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) as Markdown.
hadi-march/dom/to-markdown#toMarkdown.tr: Bir DOM ağacını (alt öğeleri blok olan bir kök: p, h1–h6, blockquote, ul / ol, pre, hr) Markdown olarak yazar.
